framework_lessons: Test plumbing forecasts against all competing balance-sheet flows.
assessment: Several measurable forecasts failed: Treasury maturity, RRP peak, Q1 crypto direction, MARA put and Tencent bottom. Inflation persistence and taper timing worked, and utility mining colocation became commercial. The lending discussion correctly names liquidation cascades but overrelies on management sophistication and off-exchange custody as protection. The liquidity framework is useful only when issuance composition and actual facility counterparties are checked.
